header: From one freight contract to three studios
subheadline: The short version of ten years: what we took on, what it taught us, and where the studio ended up. The dates are when the work shipped rather than when the contract was signed, which is the only measure a client ever cared about.

events.title: The studio starts with one client
events.description: Ana Marques and Tomás Ferreira redraw the Northwind Logistics dispatch board in nine weeks, working from a rented desk in Lisbon.

events.title: Research becomes its own practice
events.description: Inês Duarte joins to run field studies. Every engagement since opens with two weeks of interviews before a drawing file is touched.

events.title: Copenhagen and the health work
events.description: Henrik Bech opens the third studio and Atlas takes on its first regulated medical product, the Vireo Health patient portal.
